parsed.draft_response:
Hi team—thanks for reporting this. I’m sorry for the disruption. We understand that the CSV export button on the **invoice page** started returning a **500 error** this morning, and that **customer exports are unaffected**. We’ll escalate this to engineering to investigate and restore invoice-page CSV exports as a priority before Friday close.

To help engineering pinpoint the cause faster, could you share the following (even partial info is fine)?
1) The exact **time** the issue started (with timezone) and whether there were any recent deployments/changes.
2) Whether the 500 error shows any **message/error code** in the UI or browser console.
3) Who is affected (all users vs specific roles) and whether it fails for **all invoices** or only certain invoices (date range, currency, etc.).
4) Steps to reproduce and any details about the request (e.g., invoice page filters used, date range, etc.).

In the meantime, we’ll continue to support your current manual workaround and make sure engineering has enough detail from your side to resolve the invoice page export failure quickly.

Request the minimum additional details needed to reproduce and debug the issue
Continue supporting the current manual workaround while the investigation is ongoing
safety_notes: We cannot confirm a fix timeframe or root cause without engineering investigation.
We will rely on customer-provided error details (console/logs/request parameters) to accelerate debugging.
